patch:
diff --git a/compiler/src/compiler.trb b/compiler/src/compiler.trb
index e2ce96a0..a6927008 100644
--- a/compiler/src/compiler.trb
+++ b/compiler/src/compiler.trb
@@ -839,7 +839,7 @@ def gate4_emit_checked_integer_operation(
 	return complete
 end
 
-def gate4_emit_guarded_integer_operation(
+def lower_guarded_integer_multiply(
 		mut context: Gate4EmitContext,
 		mut output: Gate4Output,
 		result: String,
@@ -865,22 +865,14 @@ def gate4_emit_guarded_integer_operation(
 	slow := gate4_emit_label(context)
 	fast := gate4_emit_label(context)
 	complete := gate4_emit_label(context)
-	if guarded == 13
-		gate4_output_line(output, "\t" + combined + " =l add " + left + ", " + right)
-	else
-		gate4_output_line(output, "\t" + combined + " =l or " + left + ", " + right)
-	end
+	gate4_output_line(output, "\t" + combined + " =l or " + left + ", " + right)
 	gate4_output_line(output, "\t" + small + " =w cultl " + combined + ", " + limit)
 	gate4_output_branch(output, small, fast, slow)
 	gate4_output_line(output, slow)
 	gate4_emit_integer_call(output, result, operation, left, right)
 	gate4_output_line(output, "\tjmp " + complete)
 	gate4_output_line(output, fast)
-	if guarded == 13
-		gate4_output_line(output, "\t" + result + " =l copy " + combined)
-	else
-		gate4_output_line(output, "\t" + result + " =l " + operation + " " + left + ", " + right)
-	end
+	gate4_output_line(output, "\t" + result + " =l " + operation + " " + left + ", " + right)
 	gate4_output_line(output, complete)
 	return
 end
@@ -1218,7 +1210,7 @@ def gate4_emit_scalar_mir(
 				if operator_id == 12
 					operator_id = 3
 				end
-				if operator_id == 13
+				if operator_id == 14
 					operator_id = 1
 				end
 				if !inline
@@ -1955,24 +1947,18 @@ def lower_binary_operand(
 			)
 			gate4_emit_root_value(context, "String")
 		else
-			mut use_guarded_add := guarded_operator == 13
+			mut use_checked_add := guarded_operator == 14
 			if left_nonnegative
-				use_guarded_add = false
+				use_checked_add = false
 			end
 			if right_nonnegative
-				use_guarded_add = false
+				use_checked_add = false
 			end
-			if use_guarded_add
-				gate4_emit_guarded_integer_operation(
-					context,
-					output,
-					result,
-					left_operand,
-					right_operand,
-					"add",
-					"9007199254740992",
-					false,
-					13,
+			if use_checked_add
+				# Verified portable operands cannot overflow a signed 64-bit sum.
+				# Keep both portable checks, with no returning helper slow path.
+				gate4_emit_checked_integer_operation(
+					context, output, result, left_operand, right_operand, "add", false,
 				)
 			else
 				if gate4_take_inline_budget(context)
@@ -2015,7 +2001,7 @@ def lower_binary_operand(
 		return result
 	end
 	if operator_id == 3
-		gate4_emit_guarded_integer_operation(
+		lower_guarded_integer_multiply(
 			context,
 			output,
 			result,
diff --git a/compiler/src/compiler_test.trb b/compiler/src/compiler_test.trb
index cffcb91c..48775b06 100644
--- a/compiler/src/compiler_test.trb
+++ b/compiler/src/compiler_test.trb
@@ -168,7 +168,7 @@ describe("Gate 4 TypeRB frontend") do
 		expect(qbe.include?(", 67108864")).to_be_true()
 		expect(gate4_occurrence_count(qbe, "call $g4_integer_mul")).to_equal(1)
 
-		state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][4] = 14
+		state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][4] = 15
 		expect(gate4_verify_mir(state.scalar_mir, true)).to_equal(
 			"MIR scalar binary type differs",
 		)
@@ -177,7 +177,7 @@ describe("Gate 4 TypeRB frontend") do
 		expect(gate4_verify_mir(state.scalar_mir, true)).to_equal("MIR failure target does not exist")
 	end
 
-	test("selects a verified guarded Integer add for loop-local scalar MIR") do
+	test("selects a verified full-range Integer add for loop-local scalar MIR") do
 		source := "def sum(left: Integer, right: Integer): Integer\n\treturn left + right\nend\n\ndef main()\n\tlefts := [1]\n\trights := [2]\n\tmut index := 0\n\twhile index < 1\n\t\tvalue := sum(lefts[index], rights[index])\n\t\tindex += value\n\tend\n\treturn\nend\n"
 		mut state := gate4_compiler_new(source.size() + 1)
 		expect(gate4_lex(state, source)).to_be_true()
@@ -191,16 +191,17 @@ describe("Gate 4 TypeRB frontend") do
 		block := state.scalar_mir.blocks[function[6]]
 		instruction_index := block[5]
 		expect(state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][0]).to_equal(7)
-		expect(state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][4]).to_equal(13)
+		expect(state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][4]).to_equal(14)
 		qbe := gate4_output_source(gate4_emit_qbe(state))
-		expect(qbe.include?(", 9007199254740992")).to_be_true()
-		expect(qbe.include?("call $g4_integer_add(l ")).to_be_true()
+		expect(qbe.include?(", 9007199254740991")).to_be_true()
+		expect(qbe.include?(", -9007199254740991")).to_be_true()
+		expect(qbe.include?("call $g4_integer_add(l ")).to_be_false()
 
-		state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][4] = 14
+		state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][4] = 15
 		expect(gate4_verify_mir(state.scalar_mir, true)).to_equal(
 			"MIR scalar binary type differs",
 		)
-		state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][4] = 13
+		state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][4] = 14
 		state.scalar_mir.instructions[instruction_index][5] =- 1
 		expect(gate4_verify_mir(state.scalar_mir, true)).to_equal("MIR failure target does not exist")
 	end
diff --git a/compiler/src/mir.trb b/compiler/src/mir.trb
index c273a245..a613beb7 100644
--- a/compiler/src/mir.trb
+++ b/compiler/src/mir.trb
@@ -349,7 +349,7 @@ def gate4_mir_induction_address(
 		return false
 	end
 	if add[4] != 1
-		if add[4] != 13
+		if add[4] != 14
 			return false
 		end
 	end
@@ -408,7 +408,7 @@ def gate4_mir_induction_address(
 		return false
 	end
 	if reduction[4] != 1
-		if reduction[4] != 13
+		if reduction[4] != 14
 			return false
 		end
 	end
@@ -511,7 +511,7 @@ def gate4_optimize_verified_mir(mut native_module: Gate4MirModule)
 		if instruction[0] == 7
 			if instruction[5] >= 0
 				if instruction[4] == 1
-					instruction[4] = 13
+					instruction[4] = 14
 				else
 					if instruction[4] == 3
 						instruction[4] = 12
@@ -734,7 +734,17 @@ def gate4_mir_instruction_error(
 		if operator == 12
 			operator = 3
 		end
-		if operator == 13
+		# Plan 14 keeps the complete portable range and original failure edge.
+		if operator == 14
+			if first_type != 1
+				return "MIR checked add type differs"
+			end
+			if second_type != 1
+				return "MIR checked add type differs"
+			end
+			if result_type != 1
+				return "MIR checked add type differs"
+			end
 			operator = 1
 		end
 		mut numeric := false
